title: Illustrative summary (not official guideline text): 2024 ESC Guidelines for Heart Failure Management

treatment.content: Guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) for HFrEF includes ACE-I/ARB/ARNI, beta-blockers, MRAs, and SGLT2 inhibitors.
key_points: Quadruple therapy is standard: ACE-I/ARB/ARNI + BB + MRA + SGLT2i
Start SGLT2i early in all HFrEF patients
Titrate to target or maximally tolerated doses

disclaimer: Short summary written for this research prototype. It is not the official guideline text and has not been checked against it. Not medical advice.
